root_cause: KubeJS2101 wraps the top-level global Map in GlobalUnmodifiableMap in client/server scripts; replacing global.AIA2Core, global.AIA2 or global.AIA2Machines is forbidden. Rhino2101.2.7 does not expose globalThis.
fix: startup_scripts/aia2/00_shared_state.js initializes the pure AIA2Core and stable AIA2/AIA2Machines object containers in the writable startup phase.
server_scripts/aia2/00_core.js validates the bootstrap and removes old nested API closures on server-script reload.
20_progression.js and 25_machine_guard.js copy members into existing containers without writing top-level global entries.
Existing dependent scripts keep the same global.AIA2Core/global.AIA2/global.AIA2Machines aliases. No globalThis is used.
Persistent team data remains in server.persistentData under aia2_runtime_v1; schema and prior quest/item IDs are unchanged.

source_contracts.artifact_kind: Unmodified exact-pin official Java core compiled from source, not the published mod JAR

installation: A full game/client/server restart is required once to load the new startup bootstrap. /reload alone cannot supply missing startup state.
preservation: No world files, player/team progress or quest IDs were removed or reset. Unknown chapters in the actual Windows instance remain outside this repository and must be retained by the installer.
test_scope: Actual Rhino executes the unchanged startup/server scripts against modeled Java API bindings. Minecraft/NeoForge startup, real mod event dispatch, inventory serialization, native guard tick interception and TPS require in-game validation.
